items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Let me see, Lee Polk was on one side of me, Eddie was on the other side of me

ctx.x: would get high, he figured people were picking on him. Now, Lee Polk came in the band. When Lee Polk came in the band, he and Lee Polk... Lee Polk was a tenor player, and him and Eddie became very good friends. They were real buddies, you know.

Well, when we were sitting all next one another... Let me see, Lee Polk was on one side of me, Eddie was on the other side of me, and I'm in the middle between them two, and then there's two more saxophones -- we had five saxophones.
I've got here Bob Dorsey and Greely Walton.
